scope: Shared current Session play/pause/previous/next and advertised current-track save, explicit user input only.
authority: Existing paired command HTTP handler resolves authorized device and Profile, then calls the selected backend. No expected Session/item wire field, grant, audio path or contract added.
preflight: Fresh isolated owner Session GET must match the original active Session and playback item/state/source; then status command read must match backend/revision/availability, strict favorite capability when needed, and the observed URI hash (SHA256 first24 hex from released RendererSafePlaybackProjection.from_observation) plus playing/paused state. Finally one explicit command POST. No caller URI or subject override.
transport: New playback preflights/POST use configured HA, normal paired device/Bearer/explicit Profile, redirects disabled, fresh requests.Session with trust_env false, no ambient netrc/proxy credentials/cookie reuse. No WS fallback/retry. Other existing Session calls keep their established transport.
concurrency: Dedicated max1 worker; original reference and binding checked before/after preflight and before write. Observed withdrawal, close/hide/foreground/Profile/End/Session/item/backend changes revoke queued intent. Started HTTP may complete. End stays independent; other command/input reads are gated during this intent.
display: Ignore command playback data; only normal independent owner refresh updates Runtime. A still-current visible uncertain outcome blocks further clicks until explicit refresh; no automatic write replay. UI status is not an operation1 receipt or an exactly-once claim.
design: Pinned Apple music artwork accessibility/gesture actions map to play/pause/next/previous; Pi provides an explicit More pop-out, not native artwork gesture geometry. Current-track save uses existing favorite capability and does not assert or toggle a favorite state. Pi-owned transport glyph paths reuse Main.qml geometry; not exact SF symbols.
reading: The original half-viewport first-fold threshold is also asserted with new controls active in all five locales/both formats. Existing native/current reply/history/image reading paths remain separate.
known_race: Existing producer commands are global Profile playback actions, with no atomic expected Session/item CAS. Preflight prevents observed stale dispatch but cannot prevent a server change after the last read or cancel a started command.
limits: Volume/output selection, favorite state/removal and artwork tap/swipe gestures remain open
No general playback cover/image grant is inferred from Runtime metadata
fixture: Original native expressive bytes replayed at original expiry clock; backend status, playback updates, HTTP/socket effects synthetic and intercepted. Existing renderer URI/hash mechanism used only as equality fence, never as a new right.
url_admission: Isolated playback paths reject embedded userinfo, non-HTTP(S), query/fragment, controls and invalid ports before request preparation. Offline requests probe demonstrates URL userinfo replaces Bearer despite trust_env false. Valid reverse proxy paths remain supported.
